Four friends — Ishan, Jaya, Kabir and Lata — each ordered exactly one drink at a cafe. The drinks were coffee, tea, juice and lassi, one each. The four bills were Rs 80, Rs 120, Rs 150 and Rs 200, one each.

- Lata paid Rs 80.
- Jaya paid more than Kabir but less than the person who ordered tea.
- Ishan ordered tea.
- The person who ordered juice paid Rs 150.
- Kabir did not order coffee.

Answer the questions that follow.
